blocks.text: Andres Brillantes revealed that she suffered from a burst eardrums while deep-sea diving in Oslob, Cebu for her new movie “Laya.” During a recent chat with some entertainment reporters, the actress said the incident happened when she was filming several meters below the surface in the company of whale sharks (butanding) that Oslob is known for.
